name: Google Chrome
description: Indexes Google Chrome bookmarks and browsing history from a local Chrome profile.

fields.title: Index bookmarks
fields.description: Index entries from the Bookmarks file.

fields.title: Index browsing history
fields.description: Index visited pages from the History database.

fields.title: History time range
fields.description: How far back to index browsing history. Pick the time window to index — only pages visited within it are indexed.

fields.title: Skip non-web history URLs
fields.description: Skip history entries that are not http(s) URLs (e.g. chrome://, file://, about:).
